propositions: Six high-centrality modules sit within 7 lines of the 800-LOC size cap, with three at exactly 800, blocking ordinary feature work from landing without structural prerequisites
llm/config.py has only 7 lines of headroom against the cap but absorbs 10-13 lines per new config knob, making new features impossible without decomposition
Code decomposition must target the specific shape of mass (absorbing verbs, flat declaration tables, colocated domains) and remove future-change absorbers rather than merely relocating mass
Seam tests asserting per-file headroom targets are the substitute enforcement mechanism after per-function length gates were declined as having too high blast radius
Relocation of abstractions across new module boundaries must preserve existing test structure with zero edits to maintain cut validity
